bio: Nikola Karev was a teacher and socialist from Kruševo. During the Ilinden Uprising in August 1903 the insurgents took the town and declared the Kruševo Republic, with Karev as its president; it lasted ten days before Ottoman forces retook it. He was killed in an ambush in 1905. Kruševo's Ilinden is celebrated every 2 August, and Karev is a national hero of Macedonia.
